history.summary: 1001 sqft 2BR at Ascentia Sky (D03 Redhill) for $2.28M / $2278 PSF, with a strong 5.9%/yr appreciation on a reliable 83-txn series and 310m to Redhill MRT — but the asking PSF is ~12% above the $2030 district median, which offsets much of the upside. Good location and appreciation track record, overpriced entry, nets to Neutral.
history.rating_rationale: Strong fundamentals — 5.9%/yr appreciation (83 txn, reliable), 310m to EW18 Redhill MRT, RCR D03 with Greater Southern Waterfront/TEL upside, and a $2.28M price in the liquid band. But $2278 PSF is ~12% over the $2030.5 median, a meaningful overpay that erodes the appreciation advantage at entry; score_1000 of 549 is only market-typical. The location is buy-grade but the price is not.

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: 2BR steps from Redhill MRT and near the city/GSW corridor rents strongly to professionals; the 1001 sqft 2BR is well-sized and marketable. Yield is modest at the high $2278 PSF entry.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: 5.9%/yr on 83 transactions is genuinely strong and RCR-typical, but buying ~12% over median means paying forward much of that gain; net appreciation to the buyer is muted unless the GSW catalyst accelerates.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_rate_source: URA resale-only CAGR (83 txn), slight haircut for above-median entry
